method: side verdicts: review (rounds 1-3 + orchestrator overrides) override mechanical auto verdicts; pair participates iff both sides participate; KU joins the domain extension set iff >= 1 participate side verdict

orchestrator_overrides.rationale: orchestrator override (5%-sample disagreement): 'MAP extends MLE by incorporating a prior over the parameters' is genuine MAP-estimation concept content (regression scope), not an incidental mention

orchestrator override (B3-sample disagreement): 'The cross-entropy between two distributions p and q' is a real definition of the log-loss metric; prose definitions without colon-gloss markers must not be auto-rejected by rule B2

verification.tier_A_sample: 30-pair fresh random sample after two calibration pull-backs (weak aliases, then canonical homonyms): ~17% residual single-side over-inclusion, exclusively in the safe direction (extra dossier evidence pointers); zero under-inclusion observed; two further pull-back iterations were assessed and rejected as they would effectively reinstate universal per-unit review removed by ADR-0011; dossier-v2 extension records are advisory to synthesis, which re-examines evidence and never blindly trusts the scaffold
verification.tier_B_sample: 20-pair sample of auto-rejects: 19/20 correct; 1 borderline-thin case (one-line loss-spike symptom in a CNN pitfall list) left as reject because the dossier carries the full treatment from its own domain files
verification.tier_B3_sample: 15-pair sample: 1 real miss (prose definition of cross-entropy without colon-gloss) overridden to participate by the orchestrator (recorded in the overrides list)
verification.review_reject_sample: 179/539 sampled reviewed rejects (5% min 30 per domain) personally re-reviewed by the orchestrator: 178/179 agreement (99.4%), 1 conservative reject->participate override, zero hidden gaps
verification.citation_checks: every reviewed-accept verdict machine-checked for a term/alias/matched_text anchor in the KU excerpt or match context (0 failures across rounds 1-3; round 4 completeness-checked)
residual_risks: Tier A retains ~17% single-side over-inclusion from canonical-term homonyms not blacklisted (entropy-for-tree, decomposition, validation-as-form-validation); all are over-inclusion, none lose knowledge (the KU ledger is independent of dossier membership)
B2 (no-gloss auto-reject) can miss prose definitions in non-domain folders; measured ~1/35 in sampling; the override mechanism exists for future sessions
The 46,978 low-signal discovery candidates and 3 confirmed gaps are untouched by this classification and remain documented non-claims
